candidate.name: Ignacio Arsuaga
candidate.startAvailability: Available to start immediately upon EAD approval

hero.label: Made for Aphid
hero.headline: I want to help Aphid bring AI workers to the world.
hero.subheadline: Aphid is attacking a real problem: people are drowning in repetitive work and AI can give that time back. The idea of selling digital workers that literally earn money for users is a fundamentally different pitch than most SaaS, and I want to be the person making that case to the market. This is the kind of role where sharp outreach and genuine belief in the product compound into real growth.

whyCompany.title: AI workers that earn money, not just save clicks, changes the pitch entirely
whyCompany.body: Most AI tools sell efficiency. Aphid sells economic value, which is a much stronger buying argument and a much easier conversation to start. That framing makes every cold outreach sharper because the ROI is concrete, not abstract. I want to learn how to sell that story and help refine it.

whyCompany.title: Early-stage hiring means the BD playbook is still being written
whyCompany.body: Joining now means I am not inheriting a script, I am helping build one. At Copygen.ai I was one of the first people doing outbound and watched the process go from zero to real paying clients. That environment is where I learn fastest and contribute the most. Aphid at this stage feels like exactly that moment.

whyCompany.title: My BDR track record maps directly to what this role demands
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach end to end using HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences and helped bring in 10 to 12 paying clients from scratch. At NextAfter I sharpened my understanding of how digital channels and messaging work together to drive conversions in B2B contexts. Aphid needs someone who can open doors and move fast, and that is exactly what I have been doing.

quote: I have spent the last year and a half proving that outbound works when you actually believe in what you are selling. I believe in what Aphid is building, and I want to be the person putting it in front of the right people.
